description: A jQuery plugin that creates a switch widget using radio buttons, supporting accessibility and customizable options.

methods.name: __init
methods.description: Initializes the radio switch widget, creating DOM elements, setting initial state, and binding event handlers.

methods.name: __doSwitch
methods.description: Internal method to switch the widget state to 'on' or 'off', updating classes and ARIA attributes.

methods.name: doSwitch
methods.description: Public method to change the switch state, optionally firing a change event.

methods.name: doEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables the entire widget, affecting user interaction.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the widget, including whether it is 'on' and enabled.
